name: open_bundle_resources
description: Open a local app bundle for read-only plist, Interface Builder, asset catalog, and keyed archive inspection without resolving or inventing its executable identity. This switches the shared session to a resource-only lane; executable analysis is unavailable until another target is opened.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis target; relative paths are rejected.
